svg.aria-label: Lumen screen probes: filtered radiance atlas
svg.title: Lumen screen probes: filtered radiance atlas
svg.desc: Captured buffer visualization. Lumen screen probes: filtered radiance atlas graph 0001 | Lumen.ScreenProbeGather.ScreenProbeFilteredRadiance | pass 172 | linear radiance radiance (shared per-figure tonemap) INVALID_LIGHTING sentinel valid zero non-finite ScreenProbeFilteredRadiance is the spatially/temporally filtered octahedral radiance atlas consumed by screen-probe integration. The exact INVALID_LIGHTING triple (65024,65024,64512) is masked as a categorical invalid tile; a valid zero radiance remains black. The atlas is 640x672 texels, not a screen image; the octahedral 8x8 texel blocks are visible at native resolution.
